name: gm-tools-review-ui
description: Phase 6 dedicated web review UI: a small node:http server (server.mjs) over mutation-engine/time-skip's existing library modules (via wf-mcp-server/lib/mutation-ops.mjs, shared verbatim with the MCP server), plus a vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend (public/) -- no framework, no build step, matching this project's established convention. Phase 15 added Playwright as a devDependency (a committed real-browser regression suite, dev/test-only, run via `npm run test:e2e`). Phase 26 task 26.10 PROMOTES it to a real runtime dependency (see dependencies below) -- deliberately, flagged explicitly (not slid in silently): wf-mcp-server/lib/foundry-push.mjs's real POST /api/entities/:entityId/foundry-push route now launches real headless Chromium at runtime (mirroring foundry_worldFabric/gm/gm-say.mjs's own login + ChatMessage.create pattern, §26.F) to push an entity's description into live Foundry chat -- the first genuine runtime (not just test-time) use of Playwright in this package.
